title: I cant waitttttt to see @The Notebook one last time 💙 #rushtickets #b...
transcript: I got rushed to get to the notebook and I didn't think I was going to. So this is why you should always stay in line. I got to the rush line at 9:30, which is later than I was intending to, and there was probably like 17 people in front of me and I almost just laughed cause I was like, there's no way this is happening. I was already in line and there was nothing else I was planning on seeing tonight, so I figured I would hold out. Online it said it was sold out, so I wasn't sure even how many rush tickets there would be. And when the box office finally opened, they said there was two seats that were not rush. There were two 90 dollar tickets not together. And then everything else was standing. So immediately four people just left the line cause they did not want to stand or were unable to stand, which is valid. But then as people would approach the box office, I think, I don't know, they thought something would change because when they got to the front and realized it was still only standing, they were like, never mind, I would leave. So when I got to the front, I was just able to get to standing for tonight. Very excited. I did, yes. Standing for two and a half hours. It's not fun, but there's a ledge and I feel like the view really good. I Haven't seen the new cast of The Notebook, so for me it was worth standing to see the new cast, then to miss them entirely. Anyway, stay in line even if it looks bleak. You never know.
